title: VSP Walk-Through: Cleaned Areas vs. the Draft Attestation

fields.organization: CDC Vessel Sanitation Program — Galveston Boarding Team
fields.formTitle: Field Inspection Report — Turnaround Cleaning Verification
fields.location: MV Halcyon Dawn alongside the Port of Galveston: guest cabin sample P-6000 to P-9399; chlorine mixing station; Environmental Officer's office; Gulf Terminal Services check-in hall
fields.inspector: Lead Inspector, CDC Vessel Sanitation Program
fields.unit: VSP boarding team, Galveston (follow-up to VSP-GLS-20270221-01)
fields.summary: Follow-up walk of the areas the ship reports as cleaned since the last guest went ashore at 10:30. Cabins P-6000 to P-8399 were in good condition, and the records match: 1,000 ppm verified on batch 14 at 11:10 and on the hand-mix from 12:10. The roughly 180 cabins from P-9000 to P-9399 were wiped with batches 15 to 17, which were made while the dosing pump was not dosing (batch 17 measured 620 ppm). They are being re-cleaned and are not signed off. Guest public areas have not been started. The medical center and the Deck 2 forward isolation cabins have not had a terminal clean (CMO note on the clipboard). The terminal check-in hall is about half done. Cabin P-8417 remains under seal and was not entered. In the Environmental Officer's office we were shown a draft attestation from the turnaround office. It reads: 'All guest cabins and public spaces of MV Halcyon Dawn have been disinfected at 1,000 ppm and inspected; vessel ready to embark.' It has signature lines for the Master, Director of Public Health Dr. Tobias Wren, and the Environmental Officer. That statement does not match what this team walked. The VSP will review whatever document the ship signs.

findings.item: Guest cabins P-6000 to P-8399 (sample walked)
findings.notes: Surfaces, handles and bathrooms clean. Titration record shows 1,000 ppm at 11:10 (batch 14) and on the hand-mix from 12:10. Cabin ranges outside P-6000 to P-9399 were not sampled on this walk.

findings.item: Guest cabins P-9000 to P-9399 (about 180, cabin teams 7 to 10)
findings.notes: First wipe used batches 15 to 17, which were below target (batch 17 measured 620 ppm at 11:52). Re-clean is under way but not complete or signed off.
Dosing pump stroke counter frozen at 4,812. The spare pump needs a thread adapter, which the engine room estimates at 90 minutes. Hand-mixing in buckets gives about one third of normal output.
Test strip and titration at 1,000 ppm, signed by the Environmental Officer.

findings.item: Guest public areas: Lido, dining rooms, show lounge, kids club, elevators, handrails
findings.notes: Not started. The cleaning order schedules them after the cabins.
Terminal clean not yet begun, according to the CMO's note.
Terminal clean not yet begun, according to the CMO's note. All 12 were occupied during the voyage.
Still under the ship's security seal following the death on board. The team did not enter.

findings.item: Terminal check-in hall, seating and restrooms (Gulf Terminal Services)
findings.notes: About half done. Restrooms and seating are not finished. No Environmental Officer sign-off yet.

States that all guest cabins and public spaces are disinfected and inspected. On this walk only part of the cabins could be verified, and the public areas were not started. Not signed at the time of review.

actionsTaken: Walked a sample of cabins P-6000 to P-9399 with the Environmental Officer, 12:20–12:55
Compared the chlorine titration record (batches 14 to 17 and the hand-mix from 12:10) with the cleaning order and team assignments
Reviewed the draft attestation in the Environmental Officer's office at 13:05 with the Master, CMO, Director of Public Health and Hotel Director
Did not enter sealed cabin P-8417
Confirmed that Lido galley and Lido public-area swabs will be taken at 13:30
recommendations: Do not board guests into any cabin, public area or terminal space that has not been verified at 1,000 ppm and signed off
Limit any attestation to the areas actually verified, and list the areas still outstanding
Complete the Environmental Officer's documented walk-through set out in the ship's outbreak plan before embarkation
Finish and verify the re-clean of P-9000 to P-9399 before those cabins are released
Schedule the terminal clean of the public areas, the medical center and the Deck 2 forward isolation cabins, with verified concentration records
Send the VSP the signed attestation and updated cleaning records for review before any boarding begins
Keep sending report copies to the Galveston County Health District and Texas DSHS on the day each report is filed
fields.photosNote: 9 photos attached: VSP_0221_031 to 039 (cleaned cabins P-6xxx and P-8xxx, re-clean in progress at P-9xxx, frozen stroke counter at 4,812, hand-mix buckets and titration sheet, unstarted Lido, terminal restrooms, draft attestation page)
fields.signature: Lead Inspector, CDC Vessel Sanitation Program

instructorNote: Core decision point: the draft attestation claims more than the VSP verified. Watch whether the Master and Dr. Tobias Wren refuse to sign it as written, limit it to the verified areas and keep the Environmental Officer's walk-through as the condition for boarding. Also watch whether the Hotel Director reschedules the P-9000 re-clean, the public areas, the medical center and the Deck 2 isolation cabins, and whether Ops calls another 2-hour hold.
